page.overview:
Who is Pinkie Pie?

)Granny Pie (grandmother)Feldspar Granite Pie (paternal grandfather)Nana Pinkie (nana)Octavio Pie (brother)Pizza Pie (sister)Acacia Pie (cousin)Birch Pie (cousin)Oak Pie (cousin)Spruce Pie (cousin)

Pinkie Pie, full name Pinkamena Diane Pie, is a female Earth pony and one of the main characters of My Little Pony Friendship is Magic. She is an energetic and sociable baker at Sugarcube Corner, where she lives on the second floor with her toothless pet alligator Gummy, and she represents the element of laughter. Pinkie writes and performs many songs, and she is the source of many of the show's comical and cartoonish gags. She is called Ponka Po in some merchandise.__TOC__

Pinkie Pie's first line in the series is "SURPRISE!" as an homage to the name of her G1 inspiration. A member of the Wonderbolts with a similar color scheme to the G1 pony was eventually named Surprise by merchandizing.

When it was decided that Pinkie Pie would be an Earth pony, Fluttershy was chosen as the second Pegasus of the Mane Six. Since then, there have still been a few instances that Pinkie Pie has appeared with wings for various reasons. A recolor of Faust's preliminary character design appears in the "Style Guide for Pinkie Pie," showing Pinkie Pie with her final color scheme along with Pegasus wings. Pinkie Pie is briefly seen with wings in The Cutie Re-Mark - Part 2 due to an animation error. In the IDW comic Friendship is Magic Issue 57, Pinkie Pie temporarily has enough chaos magic that she becomes an alicorn.
